university.name: Lancaster University
university.summary: Lancaster University has its main campus at Bailrigg, about three miles south of the City of Lancaster. It teaches undergraduate and postgraduate courses and publishes international scholarships, including regional awards that name Pakistan.

scholarships.name: Undergraduate International Regional Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 per year of study as a tuition fee reduction
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction for international fee-paying undergraduates from 14 named countries, including Pakistan, on full-time on-campus degrees at Bailrigg. Eligible applicants are identified automatically, with no separate application.
scholarships.criteria_text: National of, or with a permanent home address in, one of the 14 listed countries; international fee-paying; full-time undergraduate degree fully on campus at Bailrigg; offer conditions met. Not available for repeated years and cannot be deferred.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.intake_label: 2026 entry terms (2027 entry terms not yet published)
scholarships.notes: The page describes 2026 entry. Lancaster's 2027 course pages say the 2026 entry scholarships can be used as a guide, so 2027 terms need confirming. The page says the award cannot be deferred to a later entry year.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate International Regional Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction for international applicants from 14 named countries, including Pakistan, on full-time taught Master's degrees on the Bailrigg campus. Eligible applicants are identified automatically, with no separate application.
scholarships.criteria_text: Nationality or permanent home address in a listed country; average grade to date of a 1st or 2:1 (or equivalent); full-time taught Master's (MA, MSc, MBA, LLM or EMBA) on the Bailrigg campus, not MSc by Research or online; accepted offer; external funding below 50% of the tuition fee; remains an international fee payer.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.intake_label: 2026 entry terms (2027 entry terms not yet published)
scholarships.notes: The page describes an accepted 2026 offer. Lancaster's 2027 course pages say the 2026 entry scholarships can be used as a guide, so 2027 terms need confirming. The page says the award cannot be deferred and can be combined only with the Alumni Loyalty Scholarship.

scholarships.name: Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship (International)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 per year of study as a tuition fee reduction
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction for international fee-paying undergraduates with A*AA or higher at A level, or an equivalent, who make Lancaster their firm UCAS choice. It is awarded automatically through the university application.
scholarships.criteria_text: A*AA or above at A level or equivalent; Lancaster is the firm UCAS choice; international fee-paying; full-time on-campus degree at Bailrigg. Not available to International Study Centre progression students, for repeated years, or if the offer is deferred.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.intake_label: 2026 entry terms (2027 entry terms not yet published)
scholarships.notes: The page describes 2026 entry. The page says it can be combined with the Undergraduate Regional Scholarship and with named departmental scholarships. No Pakistan equivalent grade is stated.
